full_judgment: 13. PW 10 Mallik Md. Ruhul Islam is the same-self person who deposed in this case as PW 1. He is the informant as well as the Investigating Officer in this case. He stated that he made a General Diary entry on 4.11.91, Ext. 5, He himself lodged a First Information Report on 11.4.91 Ext. 3. He stated that he visited the place of occurrence, prepared the sketch map with index. He stated that he recorded statements of the witnesses under section 161 CrPC and being satisfied that the charges leveled against them are proved, he submitted charge sheet against the accused persons under section 19(a) & (f) of the Arms Act, 1878. In cross-examination he stated that they did not bring the accused persons to the police station. He further stated in his cross-examination that two staffs, who opened the door of Chittagong Muslim Hotel were not traceable. Therefore, they could not be brought before the dock to depose as witnesses in this case. He further stated that they were not even made accused in this case. He stated that he does not know Solaiman Mistry, the owner of "Moon Hotel". However, in cross examination he admitted that Moon Hotel is situated in a very important place of Barisal town and the value of the hotel would be around one crore taka. He denied to have known the decree that was obtained by father of the accused-appellant against the owner of the Moon Hotel in Title Suit No. 119 of 1982 in the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge, Barisal. He further denied to have known anything in respect of Title Suit No. 61 of 1984. He stated that it is not correct that the papers of judgment and decree in respect of the said suit were filed before the Investigating Officer. He denied that the accused persons were falsely implicated in this case out of enmity.
